title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. In my dream, I saw myself in a school, where I saw a couple of children coming out of classrooms wearing back uniforms on. As I was walking, I found myself walking towards this room. The buldingb was very quiet, it was not loud or noisy as most schools are. When I walked into the room, I found my friend sitting down with a child. (Please note, my friend is not married)When I saw her in my dream she was holding a beautiful baby boy. He had bright blonde and black hair. Black hair at the bottom, not very visible and blonde hair on the top, it was very bright. When I approached my friend, the baby boy that she was holding was not in her control. He kept fiddling around. He almost like a hyperactive child. I put my hands forward to pick him up, when i picked him up, i held him for a couple of seconds, and then i gave him back to my friend. Once i gave him back, he fell asleep really quickly. I know this sounds weird brother, but please help me with the meaning of this dream. Ps.. I have sent you a couple of questions before too. Please could you get back to me about those and could you also make sure my answers are written back to me in english? 1399 views Q. My new dream that i saw during the month of ramadan after the SEHRI. I saw that i along with my family are on a journey to baitullah in makkah for an OMRA. when we reach there i lose my family and i am looking for them in the mosque. I am carrying luggage of someone and i want to find him and give him his luggage.i look for him in all the haram including inside the main black ka'aba but i dont find him. I think that it is the luggage of my university friend. Everyone is busy in praying and in TAWAF but i am searching for him. i even loose my asr prayer due to our journey to makkah and searching. Someone tell us that it is the time for IFTAR so we break our fast(ROZA). but when i came out and see the sky, it is still day. SO i get very upset for my roza, prayer and the luggage. then i find my family but not the person. In the mean time I get up. PLEASE i am very upset due to this dream because I don't pray there. So please give me the meaning of this dream. 1997 views Q. 1)Can one pray Nafil namaz in sitting position? 2)Nowadays people keep a beard after reaching old age. Is this correct? answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 13990 Country: India Title: Asalamualaykum mufti sahab,, I saw this dream twice, i saw that my father has passed away can you please tell what does it means?? Question: Asalamualaykum mufti sahab,, I saw this dream twice, i saw that my father has passed away can you please tell what does it means?? Answer ID: 13990 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1418/1117=H/1430) It is blessed dream, it means that your father will enjoy visible and invisible progress in the matter of religion, in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
